purpose: Comprehensive Event Management, Secure Public Projection, Dynamic URLs & Check-in Platform Update
buildNotes: Added /events data model and event selector integration.
Enforced unguessable token (24+ chars) and unique confirmation code (ZM-XXXXXX) generation.
Integrated /publicGuests collection to insulate sensitive guest info (phone/email/notes) from public reads.
Updated invitation path dynamically considering GitHub Pages base directory.
Implemented check-in lookup by Confirmation Code, Phone, or Name with duplicate check-in prevention.
Updated audit logs with serverTimestamp and strict role-based Firestore security rules.
